title: Strengthening the Therapeutic Relationship, Optimizing Expectations, Professional Preparation
summary: In this study, we are investigating whether a brief additional educational discussion can influence attitudes towards outpatient psychotherapy and what effects this in turn has on the therapy. The aim of the planned study is to find out how people who are about to start therapy can best be prepared for it so that they can derive the greatest possible benefit from the treatment.
conditions: Voluntary study participants are patients of the internal psychotherapy outpatient clinic, during the probationary period

interventions.name: Control group: Handing out a flyer for self-study

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Consent to participate
Exclusion criteria:
No sufficient knowledge of German for the intervention
